description: A country's double taxation treaties (DTAs, DTAAs) as CalcBloc stores them, each read from an official copy (the partner country's tax authority or treasury): the maximum withholding tax the source country may charge on dividends (and the lower rate for a qualifying shareholding), interest, royalties and fees for technical services, each with its condition, article and the article's wording; each country's method of relief from double taxation (credit or exemption); signature and entry-into-force dates; whether the MLI modifies the treaty; and the source. Stored for India (its treaties with the United States, Singapore, the United Kingdom, Japan, Australia and Austria); another country returns the list of countries with treaties. With partner, one treaty. Nothing is computed: a lower domestic rate, beneficial ownership, the MLI principal purpose test and anti-abuse rules still apply. Returns the official source URLs and the calcbloc.com page; not tax advice.

country.description: Country whose treaties to list: short code or English name, e.g. "in" or "India".

partner.description: Only the treaty with this country: ISO code or English name, e.g. "us", "uk" (or "gb"), "Singapore".

name: get_tax_treaties

attribution.description: Always "Data by CalcBloc"; show it with the figures.

calcblocUrl.description: The calcbloc.com page for this result.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country asked about.

sources.description: Official sources for the rates used.

retrievedAt.description: Date CalcBloc last checked the source.

inForce.description: Entry into force; null where the source does not state it.

mli.description: True when the MLI modifies the treaty; null where the source does not say.

reliefMethod.description: Each country's method of relief from double taxation: credit, exemption or exemption_with_progression.

url.description: Official copy of the treaty (tax authority or treasury).

article.description: Article and paragraph of the treaty.

kind.description: dividend, dividend_substantial (qualifying shareholding), interest, royalty or fts (fees for technical services).

rate.description: Maximum tax the source country may charge, as a decimal (0.15 = 15%).

title: Get double taxation treaty rates
